metadata.description: Evaluation dataset for NavBot POST /api/chat RAG endpoint — Plaksha University
metadata.notes: 100 ground-truth questions sourced from plaksha.edu.in (May 2026). Set EVAL_SITE_ID=plaksha.edu.in when running baselines.

examples.question: What are the BTech admission deadlines for 2026?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha BTech 2026 admissions have 5 rounds: Round 1 deadline December 20, 2025; Round 2 deadline February 15, 2026; Round 3 deadline March 21, 2026; Round 4 deadline April 30, 2026; Round 5 deadline June 7, 2026.

examples.question: How much is the annual tuition fee at Plaksha?
examples.ground_truth: The annual tuition fee for Category A students is ₹8,40,000. For the 2025 intake, tuition was Rs 7.8 lakh per annum. Additional costs include hostel fee of ₹1,55,000 and meal plan of ₹72,000 per year.

examples.question: What BTech programs does Plaksha University offer?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha offers four 4-year BTech degrees: 1) Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence, 2) Robotics & Autonomous Systems, 3) Biological Systems Engineering, 4) Data Science, Economics & Business.

examples.question: When was Plaksha University founded?
examples.ground_truth: The Reimagining Higher Education Foundation was created in 2017. Plaksha's 50-acre campus is located in SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab, and the campus opened in August 2021.

examples.question: What is the average placement package at Plaksha?
examples.ground_truth: The average CTC is INR 20 lakh per annum, and the median CTC is INR 17 lakh per annum. The CTC range is INR 8 to 65 lakh per annum.

examples.question: What scholarships are available at Plaksha?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha offers merit-based scholarships (25%-100% tuition waivers based on board exam scores 95-100% or JEE percentile 95th-100th) and need-based financial aid (25%-100% of tuition and living expenses for families with gross annual income below Rs 50 lakh). Named scholarships include: Bharti Scholarship (by Bharti Airtel Foundation), Axis Bank Scholarship (for diverse backgrounds in STEM), and Ayyalasomayajula Lalitha Scholarship Fund (for women in postgraduate programs, supported by A.T.E. Chandra Foundation).

examples.question: Tell me about the PhD program at Plaksha
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha offers a full-time PhD program starting August 2026 (Monsoon) or Spring semester. Research areas include Computer Science & AI/ML, Robotics & Autonomous Systems, Biosystems Engineering, Data Science & Economics, Environment & Clean Energy, and more. Standard fellowship is Rs 48,000/month. Special fellowships in CS & AI offer Rs 80,000/month rising to Rs 1,00,000 by year 5 (8 positions). There are 30+ active scholars across cohorts from 2021-2026.

examples.question: What research centers does Plaksha have?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha has four main research centers: 1) Indorama Ventures Center for Clean Energy (IVCCE), 2) Center for Sustainable and Precision Agriculture (CSPA), 3) Center for Water Security (CWS), 4) Center for Equitable and Personalized Health (CEPH). Additional facilities include the Binny Bansal Institute for Inventing the Future (IIF), ARK Foundation Robotics Lab, Info Edge Center for Entrepreneurship, Center for Thinking Language and Communication (CTLC), and DS Brar Center for Girls and Women in STEM.

examples.question: Where is the Plaksha campus located?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha's campus is at Alpha, Sector 101, IT City Rd, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar (Mohali), Punjab 140306. It is a 10-minute drive from Chandigarh International Airport and 30 minutes from Chandigarh city center. There are 20+ academic/research institutions within 20-30 minutes including ISB, IISER, and PGIMER.

examples.question: What companies recruit from Plaksha?
examples.ground_truth: Recruiting companies include — Consulting & Strategy: Boston Consulting Group, ICF, McKinsey & Company. Tech & Product: Flipkart, Sarvam AI, Whatfix, Wayfair, Quizizz. Finance & Analytics: Arcesium, DE Shaw, Fractal, Jefferies, JM Financial. Startups: Pixxel, LAT Aerospace, Predli. Other: Aditya Birla, Policy Bazaar, Nagarro.

examples.question: How does the need-based financial aid work at Plaksha?
examples.ground_truth: Need-based financial aid is for salaried families with gross annual income below Rs 50 lakh. Aid ranges from 25% to 100% of tuition and living expenses. Income slab Rs 0-12 lakh results in Rs 0-2.1 lakh tuition payable; income slab Rs 12-50 lakh results in Rs 2.1-6.3 lakh tuition payable. 46.3% of students receive financial aid, 26% are on full waiver. Contact: financialaid.ug@plaksha.edu.in.

examples.question: Who are some faculty members at Plaksha?
examples.ground_truth: Notable faculty include: Deepak Khemani (Professor, PhD IIT Bombay, AI), Prakarsh Singh (Chair Professor, PhD London School of Economics, Economics), Deepan Muthirayan (Assistant Professor, PhD UC Berkeley, CS & AI), Dhiraj Sinha (Assistant Professor, PhD University of Cambridge, Sensors), Pankaj Pansari (Assistant Professor, PhD University of Oxford, Machine Learning), Rajesh Sharma (Professor, PhD Nanyang Technological University, Social Computing).

examples.question: What is the Tech Leaders Fellowship?
examples.ground_truth: The Tech Leaders Fellowship (TLF) is a one-year, full-time residential postgraduate program co-created with UC Berkeley. The curriculum covers AI-ML, Data Science, Mathematics, Programming, Statistics, Computer Vision, NLP, Leadership, Entrepreneurship, and Design Thinking, taught by 15+ faculty from UC Berkeley, Purdue, UPenn, and Microsoft. The program is currently on hiatus after the Class of 2024 and will resume as a Master's program in 2025.

examples.question: What facilities does the Plaksha campus have?
examples.ground_truth: The 50-acre campus includes the Axis Bank FutureTech Building (104,000 sq ft, 4 floors) housing a High-Performance Computing Cluster, Data Analytics Lab, Human-Technology Interaction Lab, and Product Prototyping Studio. Other facilities include the Bharti Building, ARK Foundation Robotics Lab, library, maker spaces, hostel rooms, indoor sports lounge, indoor basketball court, and lawns. The campus is designed by architect Aaron Schwarz (Plan A) and is net carbon neutral.

examples.question: What is the PhD fellowship stipend at Plaksha?
examples.ground_truth: Standard PhD fellowship is Rs 48,000 per month (for candidates with Master's + 4-year Bachelor's) or Rs 42,000/month in the first year rising to Rs 48,000 (for 4/5-year degree holders). For 8 special positions in CS & AI, the stipend is Rs 80,000/month rising to Rs 1,00,000 by year 5. All PhD scholars get Rs 2 lakh professional development allowance and an international fellowship of up to 6 months with airfare and stipend covered.

examples.question: Calculate the total 4-year BTech cost at Plaksha including tuition, hostel, and meals
examples.ground_truth: Annual costs: Tuition ₹8,40,000 + Hostel ₹1,55,000 + Meals ₹72,000 = ₹10,67,000 per year. For 4 years: ₹10,67,000 × 4 = ₹42,68,000 (approximately ₹42.7 lakhs).

examples.question: What percentage of Plaksha students receive scholarships?
examples.ground_truth: 69% of students have received merit scholarship or financial aid. 33.7% of students are on full tuition waiver. 46.3% receive need-based financial aid specifically, with 26% on full waiver under financial aid. On the admissions page, it states 67% of students receive scholarships. A total of INR 53 crore has been distributed as of September 2025.

examples.question: What are the PhD application deadlines for Monsoon 2026?
examples.ground_truth: For Monsoon 2026: Applications open March 1, deadline April 30, interviews May 1-15, offers May 16-31. Eligibility requires Master's with 55%+ marks or 4-year Bachelor's with 75%+ or MPhil with 55%+. Contact: phd.academics@plaksha.edu.in.

examples.question: Which universities have Plaksha alumni gone to for higher education?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha alumni have pursued Master's and PhD programs at Carnegie Mellon University, King's College London, Macquarie University, Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI, NYU, UC San Diego, University of Chicago, University of Pennsylvania, and Wake Forest University. 28% of BTech graduates pursue higher education and research.

examples.question: Tell me about the Center for Water Security at Plaksha
examples.ground_truth: The Center for Water Security (CWS) is directed by Dr. Malini Balakrishnan. Its mission is sustainable clean water access for India for the next 50 years. Research includes autonomous aquatic robots, optical sensors for heavy metal detection (Cr, As, U targeting WHO <0.1 ppm), AI for sewage treatment plant optimization, and forward osmosis technology. Faculty include Dr. Malini Balakrishnan, Dr. Prashanth Suresh Kumar, Dr. Chaitanya Lekshmi Indira, and Dr. Sandeep Manjanna. Partners include IIT Madras & ICCW, ATE Enterprise Pvt Ltd, and DigitalPaani.

examples.question: What student wellbeing and counseling support does Plaksha provide?
examples.ground_truth: Counselors are available all 7 days of the week: Dr. Shalini Sharma (PhD Punjabi University, available Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri) and Dr. Pamil Preet (available Wed/Thu/Fri/Sat/Sun). Appointments are booked via detalks.com. Programs include Wellbeing Boot Camp (with YourDost), Procrastination Skill Building, Science of Being Human initiative, and a yoga program led by Srishti Malpath.

examples.question: What loan partners does Plaksha work with for education financing?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha's loan partners include Propelld, Axis Bank, Credila Financial Services, ICICI Bank (loans from Rs 1 lakh to Rs 3 crore, unsecured up to Rs 1 crore), and Avanse Financial Services (interest from 10.5% onwards, up to 15-year tenure).

examples.question: What is the Grand Challenge Studio?
examples.ground_truth: The Grand Challenge Studio is part of Plaksha's BTech curriculum where students work on real-world challenges. It is a signature pedagogical approach across all four BTech programs.

examples.question: How many students and faculty does Plaksha have?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha has 500+ students and approximately 40 faculty members from top global institutions including MIT, Cornell, UC Berkeley, Purdue, and IITs. There are 330+ alumni. The university also has 30+ active PhD scholars across cohorts from 2021-2026.

examples.question: Who is Pankaj Pansari?
examples.ground_truth: Pankaj Pansari is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University. He holds a PhD from the University of Oxford and specializes in Machine Learning.

examples.question: What student organizations exist at Plaksha?
examples.ground_truth: Student organizations at Plaksha include Kartavya (community service club) and sports committees. Events organized include Plakshathon, Bollywood Night, Fitoor x Prayas festival, Startup Sprint, and Aeternum entrepreneurship summit.

examples.question: What is the PhD professional development allowance?
examples.ground_truth: All PhD scholars receive a Rs 2 lakh professional development allowance. They also get an international fellowship of up to 6 months with airfare and stipend covered.

examples.question: How much need-based financial aid has Plaksha distributed?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha has distributed INR 44.92 crore in need-based financial aid. The total including merit scholarships is INR 53 crore as of September 2025. 46.3% of students receive financial aid.

examples.question: Tell me about Plaksha's agriculture research
examples.ground_truth: The Center for Sustainable and Precision Agriculture (CSPA) is directed by Dr. Shashank Tamaskar. Research areas include affordable precision agriculture technology, satellite/drone geospatial tech, AI farming, robotic monitoring and weeding, bio-pesticides and bio-sensors, and commodity price prediction. The ARK Foundation Robotics Lab also conducts drone-based precision agriculture research.

examples.question: Thank you for the information!
examples.ground_truth: You're welcome! If you have any more questions about Plaksha University, feel free to ask. I'm here to help with information about programs, admissions, campus life, and more.

examples.question: What is the total 4-year cost if I get full tuition waiver but pay hostel and meals?
examples.ground_truth: With full tuition waiver, you only pay hostel (₹1,55,000/year) and meals (₹72,000/year) = ₹2,27,000 per year. For 4 years: ₹2,27,000 × 4 = ₹9,08,000 (approximately ₹9.1 lakhs).

examples.question: Who is Brainerd Prince?
examples.ground_truth: Brainerd Prince is an Associate Professor at Plaksha with a PhD from Middlesex University, specializing in Philosophy of Language. He is the Founding Director of the Center for Thinking, Language and Communication (CTLC).

examples.question: What is the YTS+ summer program?
examples.ground_truth: YTS+ is a summer program run by the Binny Bansal Institute for Inventing the Future (IIF) at Plaksha. The IIF is an AI-led innovation hub with four impact clusters: Clean Energy, Healthcare, Water Security, and Agriculture.

examples.question: Compare Plaksha with IIT Delhi
examples.ground_truth: I don't have comparative information about other institutions on the Plaksha website. I can share details about Plaksha's programs, placements (avg CTC INR 20 LPA), faculty, research centers, and campus facilities. Would you like to know more about any of these?

examples.question: What are Plaksha's academic and research strengths across all departments?
examples.ground_truth: Plaksha has strengths across multiple areas: Computer Science & AI (with faculty from Oxford, UC Berkeley, IIT Bombay), Robotics (ARK Foundation Lab with autonomous drones, underwater robots), Clean Energy (IVCCE center for urban heat mitigation and smart buildings), Water Security (CWS with autonomous aquatic robots and AI for sewage treatment), Agriculture (CSPA with precision ag and drone tech), Health (CEPH for point-of-care diagnostics), Economics (faculty from LSE), and Entrepreneurship (Info Edge Center with Startup Sprint). Research partners include UC Berkeley, Cornell, MIT, Cambridge, Imperial College, and IISc.
